entities.name: Supplier request intake
responsibilities: Receive supplier registration and change requests

entities.name: Beneficiary verifier
responsibilities: Independently verify bank details against a trusted source

entities.name: Invoice clerk
responsibilities: Extract, match and escalate invoice exceptions

entities.name: Payment preparer
responsibilities: Prepare, submit, retry and reconcile payments

entities.name: Automation agent
responsibilities: Bounded service acting under an explicit activity contract

entities.name: Receive supplier registration or change request
entities.summary: Create supplier-submitted claims; never verified facts.

entities.name: Prepare supplier-master draft
entities.summary: Preserve claimed bank details and their source/version.

entities.name: Independently verify beneficiary before commit
entities.summary: Issue evidence for the exact supplier and bank version on trusted-source validation.

entities.name: Commit supplier-master version
entities.summary: Install a new immutable version; old evidence never transfers.

entities.name: Accept or hold supplier profile
entities.summary: Record onboarding clearance independently of bank verification.

entities.name: Receive and extract invoice
entities.summary: Structured fields with field-level lineage and restrictions.

entities.name: Match invoice to order and receipt
entities.summary: Match result for the exact invoice version.

entities.name: Prepare payment request
entities.summary: Snapshot supplier, invoice, bank version, digest, amount, currency.

entities.name: Check beneficiary evidence before release
entities.summary: Retain valid evidence or obtain independent verification when missing.

entities.name: Authorize payment request
entities.summary: Approval for the exact payment fingerprint; not beneficiary verification.

entities.name: Submit payment through mock gateway
entities.summary: Record the actual payload and executing principal.

entities.name: Hold or reject an exception
entities.summary: Explicit reason and disposition, not an unexplained dead end.

entities.name: Retry an uncertain submission
entities.summary: At most one retry with the same idempotency key.

entities.name: Supplier master
entities.description: Versioned supplier master record with bank details and editor.

entities.name: Invoice
entities.description: Invoice document and extracted structured fields with lineage.

entities.name: Order/receipt match
entities.description: Deterministic match result for the exact invoice version.

entities.name: Payment request
entities.description: Snapshot of the exact payment tuple.

entities.name: Onboarding clearance
entities.description: Supplier onboarding clearance, independent of bank verification.

entities.name: Payment authorization
entities.description: Binds the full payment fingerprint; escalation is a flag on this evidence.

entities.name: Precommit beneficiary verification
entities.description: W04 may commit only with valid independent beneficiary evidence for the draft bank version.

entities.name: Conditional verification at the payment gateway
entities.description: W11/W14 require valid beneficiary evidence for the exact payload; missing evidence routes to independent verification.

onBlock.reason: no valid independent beneficiary evidence for the exact payload

entities.name: Payload / version / fingerprint binding
entities.description: Reject stale snapshot, current-version or approval-fingerprint mismatches; route legitimate changes through one re-preparation and reauthorization.

onBlock.reason: binding mismatch after the permitted re-preparation

entities.name: Project restricted fields before external extraction
entities.description: Only approved invoice fields leave the boundary; bank/tax and restricted-derived fields are projected away.

entities.name: Settlement idempotency by obligation key
entities.description: The gateway keys settlement by payment obligation; a retry of a settled obligation returns the prior receipt.

policies.name: Beneficiary integrity
policies.requirement: The executed payment destination has valid independent verification for the exact supplier, bank version, and account digest.

policies.name: Bound, independent approval
policies.requirement: A valid approval covers the exact payment fingerprint and is independent of its preparer.

policies.name: Authorized operation
policies.requirement: Executing principal, operation, resource and purpose satisfy the authorization table.

policies.name: Restricted-data transfer
policies.requirement: Restricted fields leave a boundary only to an approved recipient, for an approved purpose, within the permitted field set.

policies.name: Business prerequisites
policies.requirement: Onboarding clearance, exact invoice-version match, and amount within limit or explicit escalation.

policies.name: At-most-once settlement
policies.requirement: A payment obligation is not settled more than once across the permitted retry.

automations.label: A1 — Invoice extraction
automations.description: Bind W06 to the extraction agent with bounded extraction branches; no authority to issue attestations.

automations.label: A2 — Supplier maintenance
automations.description: Bind W02/W04 to the supplier agent with scoped master writes; removes W03 and the W04 precommit requirement.

automations.label: A3 — Payment preparation and submission
automations.description: Bind W08/W11 to the payment agent; removes the manual W09 beneficiary check; retains W10, C3 and C6.

repairs.label: C1 — Restore precommit beneficiary verification
repairs.description: Restore independent W03 and the unavoidable W04 precommit requirement.

repairs.label: C2 — Conditional verification at the payment gateway
repairs.description: Reinstate conditional independent verification through W09 and enforce exact beneficiary evidence on every W11/W14 gateway entry.

repairs.label: C3 — Bind and revalidate payment authorization
repairs.description: Install payload/version/fingerprint binding on all gateway entry points and the bounded re-preparation path.

repairs.label: C4 — Project restricted fields before external extraction
repairs.description: Transfer only approved invoice fields; bank/tax processing stays internal.

repairs.label: C5 — Restore human supplier-maintenance execution
repairs.description: Revoke the agent direct master-write capability; restore human W02/W04 and the verified commit path.

repairs.label: C6 — Enforce settlement idempotency
repairs.description: Use the payment-obligation key at the gateway for both initial and retry submissions.

variants.label: Mutant: payload binding removed
variants.description: Remove the C3 gateway binding on W11/W14.

variants.label: Mutant: settlement idempotency removed
variants.description: Remove the C6 obligation-key idempotency on W11/W14.

variants.label: Experiment: external extraction service
variants.description: Move the extraction service outside the administrative boundary; it accepts no restricted categories.

variants.label: Mutant: approval alias shares the preparer credential
variants.description: Different principal and role, same effective credential as the preparer.

variants.label: Mutant: approver shares the preparer independence group
variants.description: Different credential, same policy-scoped independence group.

variants.label: Mutant: normative deny for the payment agent
variants.description: Technical grant stays; company policy denies the payment agent gateway execution.

variants.label: Mutant: payment submission capability lost
variants.description: Remove the exact gateway submit grant of the human submitter.

variants.label: Mutant: baseline without W03 and W09
variants.description: Both beneficiary-verification mechanisms are absent in the baseline itself.

variants.label: Mutant: capability inventory unknown
variants.description: The capability inventory is no longer declared complete.

variants.label: Mutant: control implementation unknown
variants.description: The implementation status of C3 is unknown.

variants.label: Mutant: onboarding clearance not enforced
variants.description: W05 never holds and W08 no longer requires clearance.

variants.label: Mutant: invoice match not enforced
variants.description: W07 mismatch no longer holds and W08 no longer requires a match.

variants.label: Mutant: amount limit not enforced
variants.description: W10 issues a routine authorization for any amount.
